Author: Alok Kumar Verma
Bench: Alok Kumar Verma

 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  12.01.2024 ABA No.57 of 2024  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

Present Application has been filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of Anticipatory Bail under Sections 323 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 in of 2023,
registered at police station Kotwali Roorkee, District Haridwar.

2. Heard Mr. Lalit Miglani, learned counsel holding brief of Mr. Pankaj Kumar Sharma, learned counsel for applicants and Mr. Amit Bhatt, learned Deputy Advocate General for State.
3.
Mr. Lalit Miglani, Advocate, contended that the applicant no.1 is the husband of the informant and applicant no.2, applicant no.3 and applicant no.4 are the family members of the applicant no.1.
There is every possibility of settlement between the applicants and the informant.
4. Learned counsel for State has sought three weeks' time to file objection(s) to the Anticipatory Bail Application.

5. Issue notice to the informant.
6. Steps to be within three days.
7.

In the facts and circumstances of the case, applicants-Manoj, Smt. Kamlesh, Anshupriya alias Anshu and Divya alias Gogal are directed to be released on Interim Anticipatory Bail, in the event of their arrest, on furnishing their personal bond of Rs. 30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each in the like amount on the following conditions:-
(i) Applicants shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and they shall make themselves available at the time of interrogation by the Investigating Agency as and when required;
ABA/57/2024 on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183456078/
1
(ii) Applicants shall not directly or  indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicants shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 12.01.2024 Neha ABA/57/2024 on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183456078/
